lede: Regulatory compliance monitoring and reporting helps compliance, risk and audit professionals track controls and document adherence to requirements. The course builds practical skills in planning control tests, measuring compliance performance, investigating incidents and preparing evidence-based reports with audit trails. Participants also practise developing risk-based corrective actions and presenting findings through dashboards and executive briefings.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, monitor, or report on regulatory compliance in intermediate to complex organizational environments. It targets those who need to move from basic awareness to operational mastery of monitoring, metrics, and reporting frameworks. The course is designed for: Compliance Manager:

prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of basic compliance concepts (e.g., GDPR, SOX, AML) and familiarity with spreadsheet tools (Excel). No coding or advanced analytics experience required. Tools: Participants should bring a laptop for hands-on exercises using provided digital templates (Power BI/Tableau dashboards, Excel spreadsheets). Level: Intermediate—designed for professionals with 2-5 years of compliance experience who need to master monitoring, metrics, and reporting.
